text: Materiales de solicitud " * " significa los documentos necesarios que debe proporcionar en su solicitud. Si desea contratar nuestro servicio de traducción, debe pagarlo y reservarlo al menos 2 semanas antes de la fecha límite de solicitud para la presentación de todos los documentos; Si desea contratar nuestro servicio de tutor, debe pagarlo y reservarlo 2 meses antes de la fecha límite de solicitud, por si su solicitud falla debido a no presentar la documentación a tiempo. * 1. Plan de estudios * 2. Certificado de dominio del chino Todos los solicitantes queимен Apply for Chinese-taught program must provide HSK certificate. * 3. Self-support students must provide the guarantor’s passport copy and the certificate of work or income. * 4. Colored scanned copy of the passport Passport must open and applicants must provide scan copy of the first page and second page of passport. * 5. Digital photo(100-500K, with white background) * 6. Academic transcript of Highest Degree Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Highest degree of education (notarized copy) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
